steps.speaker: Sasha
steps.content: Hey... Why are you both so quiet?

steps.speaker: Sasha
steps.content: Was that a real fight?
Nobody answers her. The Sinners walk forward in silence, leaving Sasha behind.

steps.speaker: Sasha
steps.content: Huh? Why?! This is so boring... even more boring than before...

steps.speaker: Labyrinth
steps.content: Attempt failed. The 31st attempt.
Walking behind her, Hecate also marks the wrong route in her sketchbook.

steps.speaker: Sasha
steps.content: Hey!!! This painting... looks really strange!
Walking in the front, Sasha examines a blank painting and waves to the two behind her.
Hecate just glances at her and continues on her way. Finding the Chief as soon as possible is the most important thing to her.
Until Labyrinth walks past that painting.
The blank painting suddenly seems to come alive and starts painting itself.

steps.speaker: Labyrinth
steps.content: Confused. Is this an AI painting?
Labyrinth looks at the finished painting with a puzzled look. It's a portrait of a cat and its owner and what looks like robot parts in shadowy corners.

steps.speaker: Dahlia Guide
steps.content: This is titled Loss.
Enfer's voice starts talking as if answering Labyrinth's question or referring to something else.
Labyrinth pays little attention to the navigator. She just wants to get the mission done as soon as possible.

steps.speaker: Labyrinth
steps.content: Now, Master is still waiting for me. A.I. Maid III will follow instructions. Unless, the mission target is confirmed dead.

steps.speaker: Dahlia Guide
steps.content: What a heartless robot.

steps.speaker: Dahlia Guide
steps.content: Don't you think?
With a sigh from the AI, the painting begins to change.
Meow—
The cat's purring stops Labyrinth in her tracks, but... she doesn't know why herself.
Meow—
Labyrinth turns around and witnesses something impossible...
A cat is struggling to climb out of the painting.
The scene should feel incredibly strange... but it's weirdly familiar to her.
It was a night... a night when she lost everything.

steps.speaker: Sasha
steps.content: Hey! What are you looking at? The painting?

steps.speaker: Sasha
steps.content: Oh, the kitten is so adorable! Look at how soft and cuddly it looks...
The scene is too interesting for Sasha to miss, and she darts in with her selfie stick raised.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Don't touch it!
Unfortunately, Sasha's hand is quicker. As she touches the painting, a dense black mist erupts.
Broken people, crazed cat, and crippled robot... They burrow out of the painting one by one, making their way to the team.
